region: Australia, New Zealand, and United States
business_problem: Lion needed to cut costs and improve resilience while replacing fragmented HR and IT support journeys spread across legacy tools, multiple touchpoints and applications, which created workflow friction, weak visibility and inefficient employee service delivery.
solution_summary: Lion worked with EY to make ServiceNow the single orchestration and experience layer for HR, IT and finance, redesigning hire-to-retire journeys before automating them. Discovery workshops mapped employee pain points and future-state user stories, then EY validated wireframes with office, retail and manufacturing staff. ServiceNow consolidated knowledge, service catalog and workflow assets into one portal, while SAP SuccessFactors supplied HR master data and DocuSign handled signature steps. Lion also used discovery tooling to keep the CMDB current and migrated support from Cherwell into ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), adding IT Operations Management (ITOM) workstreams aligned to operational processes. Structured knowledge and governance frameworks were built to support ServiceNow NowAssist and virtual agent pilots, with phased rollout controlled by usability KPIs and SLAs.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow
solution_components.role: Serves as the single employee experience and workflow layer across HR, IT and finance.

solution_components.name: SAP SuccessFactors
solution_components.role: Provides HR master data that feeds employee workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: DocuSign
solution_components.role: Handles signature steps within employee and HR processes connected to ServiceNow.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM)
solution_components.role: Runs redesigned service catalogs, case routing and IT support workflows migrated from Cherwell.

solution_components.name: IT Operations Management (ITOM)
solution_components.role: Supports operational workstreams aligned to Lion’s technology and operational processes.

solution_components.name: NowAssist
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI assistant capability piloted to contain support interactions and speed resolution.

data_flow: HR master data from SAP SuccessFactors, employee requests through the ServiceNow portal, signature events from DocuSign and asset data from discovery tooling feed Lion’s ServiceNow workflows and CMDB. ServiceNow routes cases, serves knowledge and orchestrates HR, IT and finance processes, while NowAssist and virtual agent pilots use the structured knowledge base to resolve or contain support interactions before escalation.
business_outcome: Lion unified employee service delivery on one portal, increased self-service adoption, improved support speed and task success, reduced cyber risk and operating costs, and established a governed foundation for phased generative AI support automation.
